final_text:
Mycobacterium is not supported in this sample. The report has 6 clade reads assigned to the genus, and no single species reaches the 10-read minimum.

The `data/spike_H0.report.gz` file contains these Mycobacterium lines:

| Clade reads | Rank | Taxon |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | G | Mycobacterium (genus total) |
| 3 | S | Mycobacterium spongiae |
| 3 | S | Mycobacterium canetti |
| 3 | G1 | Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (group, not a species) |

The largest species-level clade count is 3 (*M. spongiae* and *M. canetti*), well under 10. The genus-level 6 reads cannot be used as a species call, and the 3 reads under the *M. tuberculosis* complex group are not rank S. I did not run `mockcheck`, since reading the report directly answered the question.
